_comment: Dork + directory templates for search_pivot.py's HANDLE and DISCORD_ID pivots — the general-web / social complement to the infrastructure pivots. An analyst tunes these WITHOUT editing Python: add a search-engine dork template, a Telegram/Discord/paste directory, or a dox-index site here and search_pivot emits it. Placeholders: {h} = bare handle (no leading @, lower-cased), {id} = numeric Discord snowflake. RULE 1 applies — these are GENERIC templates only; never paste a case value (a real handle, channel id or person) into this file. RULE 3 — code holds the matching/emit logic, this file holds the values it emits.

handle_dorks._comment: Search-engine dork templates fired across the engine set for a username/handle (Telegram, Discord, forum, marketplace alias). Each is {label, q}; {h} is substituted with the bare handle and the query is URL-encoded per engine. Keep them operator-agnostic — a handle plus a CONTEXT term (dox/market/staff) is what separates a real mention from noise.

values.label: cross-platform presence
values.q: "{h}" (telegram OR t.me OR discord OR twitter OR github OR instagram OR tiktok OR youtube OR steam)

values.label: dox / leak context
values.q: "{h}" (doxbin OR dox OR leak OR breach OR pastebin OR ghostbin OR scribd)

values.label: market / staff context
values.q: "{h}" (seller OR vendor OR shop OR market OR admin OR manager OR staff OR owner)

values.label: telegram analytics mirrors
values.q: (site:telemetr.io OR site:tgstat.com OR site:telegram.im OR site:telemetree.io) "{h}"

values.label: paste / code / dox sites
values.q: (site:t.me OR site:pastebin.com OR site:github.com OR site:scribd.com OR site:doxbin.org OR site:doxbin.net) "{h}"

telegram_directories._comment: Direct profile and third-party ANALYTICS-MIRROR URLs for a Telegram handle. The mirrors index what the app hides or shows only in-client — channel bio, the admin/management list, subscriber-count history, first-seen date — so a handle pulled from one channel's bio resolves to the operator's other channels. {h} = bare handle. Best-effort: a mirror may not have indexed a given handle, so pair with the 'telegram analytics mirrors' dork above.

discord_lookup._comment: Discord resolution. A numeric SNOWFLAKE id resolves to an account-creation timestamp (decoded locally by the tool, no network) plus username/avatar via these mirror sites; a bare username is NOT resolvable to an id, so for a username the tool falls back to the by_name dorks. by_id URLs take {id}; by_name dorks take {h}.
